description: Daily web puzzle game -- inventory tetris with alchemically reactive reagents

tasks.title: Add adjacency detection to MetaGrid
tasks.description: Add methods to MetaGrid: GetAdjacentCells(Vector2I) returns cardinal neighbor cells (up/down/left/right) that exist in the grid. GetAdjacentReagents(Reagent) returns distinct reagents occupying cells adjacent to any cell of the given reagent. Add comprehensive unit tests in tests/AlchemistCourier.Core.Tests/Grid/MetaGridTests.cs covering: empty grid, single reagent (no neighbors), two adjacent reagents, diagonal-only (not adjacent), reagent adjacent to itself (excluded), multiple neighbors.
tasks.verification: dotnet test -- new adjacency tests pass, existing 47 tests still pass

tasks.title: Add ReactionRule and ReactionResult data models
tasks.description: Create src/Core/Chemistry/ReactionRule.cs and ReactionResult.cs. ReactionRule: TriggerAspects (list of aspect names that must be co-present), SensitivityTier enum (Adjacent, SameBag, WholeInventory), Granularity enum (PerCell, PerItem), Threshold (int, for cumulative rules -- 0 means any contact triggers), ResultType (ReactionResultType enum). ReactionResult: Type (Explosion, Neutralization, Breakage, StatusEffect, Overheating, Hypothermia, Poisoning), Magnitude (float), AffectedCells (list of Vector2I), SourceRule (reference to the ReactionRule that triggered it). Add ReactionResultType enum. These are pure data models -- no logic yet. Verify dotnet build succeeds.
tasks.verification: dotnet build succeeds with zero errors

tasks.title: Add reaction rule database
tasks.description: Create src/Core/Chemistry/ReactionRuleDatabase.cs -- a static class providing GetMvpRules() returning List<ReactionRule> with the Physical/Chemistry school rules from docs/chemistry-system.md: Hot+Volatile=Explosion (Adjacent), Hot+Cold=Neutralization (SameBag), Sharp+Fragile=Breakage (Adjacent), Toxic+Toxic=ToxicCloud (SameBag), cumulative Hot threshold (Overheating, threshold=4, WholeInventory), cumulative Cold threshold (Hypothermia, threshold=4, WholeInventory), cumulative Toxic threshold (Poisoning, threshold=3, WholeInventory). Also add GetRulesForAspects(string aspect1, string aspect2) lookup method. Add unit tests verifying: correct number of rules returned, specific rule lookups work, threshold values are correct.
tasks.verification: dotnet test -- rule database tests pass

tasks.title: Add ChemistryEngine evaluator
tasks.description: Create src/Core/Chemistry/ChemistryEngine.cs with static method Evaluate(MetaGrid, List<ReactionRule>) returning List<ReactionResult>. Implementation: (1) For each adjacency rule, iterate all placed reagents, check adjacent reagents for matching trigger aspects. (2) For each same-bag rule, iterate all bags, check reagents in the same bag for matching aspects. (3) For each cumulative rule, sum aspect magnitudes across the whole inventory and check against threshold. Add comprehensive unit tests: empty grid (no reactions), two hot+volatile reagents adjacent (explosion), hot+volatile separated by gap (no reaction), cumulative heat exceeding threshold (overheating), hot+cold in same bag (neutralization), mixed scenario with multiple reactions.
tasks.verification: dotnet test -- chemistry evaluation tests pass

tasks.title: Add prospective evaluation
tasks.description: Add static method to ChemistryEngine: EvaluateProspective(MetaGrid, Reagent, Vector2I, List<ReactionRule>) returning List<ReactionResult>. This temporarily places the reagent at the given position, evaluates, then removes it -- returning what WOULD happen without mutating the grid. Implementation: clone or use temporary placement. Add unit tests: prospective place in safe spot (empty results), prospective place adjacent to volatile (explosion result), verify grid is unchanged after call.
tasks.verification: dotnet test -- prospective evaluation tests pass, grid unchanged after call

tasks.title: Add SeededRandom deterministic RNG
tasks.description: Create src/Core/SeededRandom.cs -- a deterministic random number generator. Constructor takes int seed. Methods: Next() returns int, Next(max) returns 0..max-1, Next(min, max) returns min..max-1, NextFloat() returns 0.0..1.0, Shuffle<T>(List<T>) shuffles in place. Use System.Random internally (it's deterministic given a seed in .NET). Add unit tests: same seed produces same sequence, different seeds produce different sequences, Shuffle is deterministic, Next(min,max) stays in range.
tasks.verification: dotnet test -- determinism tests pass

DifficultyParams: BagCount, BagMinSize, BagMaxSize, ReagentCount, MaxAspectCount, SpareSpacePercent, AllowSpecialBags. Add JSON serialization round-trip unit test (serialize PuzzleState to JSON string, deserialize back, verify equality).
tasks.verification: dotnet test -- serialization round-trip test passes

tasks.title: Add PuzzleGenerator
tasks.description: Create src/Core/Puzzle/PuzzleGenerator.cs implementing the disassemble-a-solution algorithm from docs/mvp-specification.md. Method: Generate(int seed, DifficultyParams) returning PuzzleState. Algorithm: (1) Create SeededRandom from seed. (2) Generate bags based on difficulty. (3) Generate reagents with aspects based on difficulty. (4) Place reagents into bags following rules (using ChemistryEngine to validate no negative reactions). (5) Record solution. (6) Remove reagents to create puzzle. Start simple: rectangular bags only, 1-2 cell reagents, basic aspects. Add unit tests: generated puzzle has non-empty bags and reagents, solution is valid (ChemistryEngine returns no negative reactions when solution is applied), same seed produces same puzzle.
tasks.verification: dotnet test -- puzzle generation tests pass, solution validates

tasks.title: Add PuzzleSolver / validator
tasks.description: Create src/Core/Puzzle/PuzzleSolver.cs with static method ValidateSolution(PuzzleState) returning bool. Checks: all reagents placed, no overlaps, all placements within bag bounds, ChemistryEngine returns no negative reactions. Also add IsSolvable(PuzzleState) that tries the stored solution. Add unit tests: valid solution validates, solution with overlap fails, solution with reaction fails, empty placement fails.
tasks.verification: dotnet test -- solver validation tests pass

tasks.title: Implement Stable aspect buffering mechanic
tasks.description: The MVP spec lists Stable as a minimum aspect, but it's missing from PuzzleGenerator.MvpAspects and has no ChemistryEngine support. Three changes needed: (1) Add 'stable' to PuzzleGenerator.MvpAspects array. (2) Add threshold-raising logic to ChemistryEngine -- when evaluating a reaction rule, check if any Stable cell is adjacent to the involved cells; if so, increase the effective threshold by the Stable magnitude. (3) Add unit tests: Stable adjacent to Hot+Volatile pair should suppress Explosion (threshold raised above 0), Stable not adjacent should not suppress, multiple Stable cells should stack. Without this, the core buffering mechanic is absent and puzzles lack strategic depth.
tasks.verification: dotnet test -- Stable buffering tests pass, PuzzleGenerator can produce puzzles with Stable reagents

tasks.title: Implement Gravity bag type
tasks.description: Add Gravity bag support to the Core layer. In a Gravity bag, reagents must be 'supported' -- placed on the bottom row of the bag or on top of existing reagents (no floating). Implementation: (1) Add BagType enum or property to Bag (Normal, Null, Gravity, Locked, etc.) if not present. (2) Add placement validation: when placing a reagent in a Gravity bag, check that every cell of the reagent is either on the bottom row or has another reagent cell directly below it. (3) Add to MetaGrid.CanPlaceReagent() or as a separate GravityValidator. (4) Update PuzzleGenerator to support Gravity bags when AllowSpecialBags is true. Add unit tests: valid placement at bottom, valid stacked placement, rejected floating placement, non-gravity bag allows floating, multi-cell reagent in gravity bag.
tasks.verification: dotnet test -- gravity bag placement tests pass

tasks.title: Implement Locked bag type
tasks.description: Add Locked bag support. A Locked bag has pre-placed reagents that can't be moved or removed by the player. Implementation: (1) Add IsLocked flag to placement data. (2) Modify PuzzleScreen/MetaGridView to prevent picking up locked reagents. (3) Update PuzzleGenerator: when generating a puzzle with locked bags, keep 1-2 reagents in their solution positions and mark them locked. (4) Update PuzzleSolver to account for locked placements. Add unit tests: locked reagent can't be removed, locked reagent aspects are active, solver handles locked placements, generator produces valid locked puzzles.
tasks.verification: dotnet test -- locked bag tests pass

tasks.title: Implement Heavy aspect falling mechanic
tasks.description: Add Heavy aspect behavior: in Gravity bags, Heavy reagents always fall to TRUE down (world gravity) regardless of bag orientation. Implementation: (1) Add 'heavy' to the Simple complexity aspect set. (2) In Gravity bag placement validation, Heavy reagents must be on the absolute bottom. (3) When placing a Heavy reagent, it 'falls' past non-Heavy reagents. (4) Heavy+Fragile crushing: if a Heavy reagent is directly above a Fragile reagent in a Gravity bag, trigger Crushing reaction. Add Crushing to ReactionResultType. Add unit tests: Heavy falls to bottom, Heavy above Fragile triggers crushing, Heavy in non-gravity bag behaves normally, Heavy placement validation.
tasks.verification: dotnet test -- Heavy falling and crushing tests pass

tasks.description: Extend PuzzleGenerator to produce non-rectangular bag shapes (L-shapes, T-shapes, irregular). Implementation: (1) Define a pool of bag shape templates (like reagent shapes but larger: L-shape, T-shape, plus-shape, irregular). (2) Modify bag generation in PuzzleGenerator to select from this pool based on difficulty. (3) Ensure placement algorithm works with non-rectangular bags (verify CanPlaceReagent checks actual bag cell occupancy, not just bounding box). Add unit tests: L-shaped bag is generated, reagent placement works in L-shaped bag, solution is valid for non-rectangular bags.
tasks.verification: dotnet test -- non-rectangular bag generation tests pass

tasks.title: Implement Volatile net-hot calculation
tasks.description: Replace the current simple Hot+Volatile adjacency explosion with the net-hot system from docs/chemistry-system.md. For each Volatile cell, calculate: net_hot = sum(adjacent Hot magnitudes) - sum(adjacent Cold magnitudes). If net_hot > effective_threshold, trigger Explosion. This makes Cold strategically useful as a heat shield near Volatile. Implementation: (1) Modify ChemistryEngine's Adjacent tier evaluation for the Explosion rule. (2) Instead of checking for Hot+Volatile pairs, iterate Volatile cells and compute net-hot from cardinal neighbors. (3) Cold adjacent to Volatile reduces net-hot. (4) Update ReactionRuleDatabase to reflect new Volatile rule definition. (5) Update existing tests and add new ones: Volatile with only Hot adjacent (explodes), Volatile with Hot and Cold balanced (safe), Volatile with more Hot than Cold (explodes), Cold as heat shield test.
tasks.verification: dotnet test -- net-hot explosion tests pass, cold-as-shield test passes

tasks.title: Implement Sharp edge placement constraint
tasks.description: Add Sharp's primary (non-parasitic) mechanic: Sharp reagents can't be placed on edge cells of non-reinforced bags. An 'edge cell' is any bag cell that has at least one cardinal neighbor that is NOT part of the same bag. Implementation: (1) Add edge detection to Bag: IsEdgeCell(Vector2I) checks if any cardinal neighbor of the cell is outside the bag. (2) Add placement validation: when placing a reagent with Sharp aspect, check if any of its cells would land on edge cells. Block placement in non-Reinforced bags. (3) Update PuzzleGenerator to respect this constraint during solution generation. Add unit tests: Sharp blocked on edge, Sharp allowed in interior, Sharp allowed on edge of Reinforced bag, multi-cell Sharp with one edge cell blocked, non-Sharp on edge is fine.
tasks.verification: dotnet test -- Sharp edge constraint tests pass

tasks.title: Implement Fragile universal vulnerability
tasks.description: Add Fragile's primary (non-parasitic) mechanic: Fragile reagents break from ANY adjacent reaction, not just Sharp. Implementation: (1) After ChemistryEngine.Evaluate computes all reactions, do a second pass: for each reaction result, check if any Fragile reagent occupies a cell adjacent to the reaction's affected cells. If so, add a Breakage result for the Fragile reagent. (2) Fragile can't be placed in Gravity bags (placement constraint). (3) Fragile reagents should have higher base value to compensate for their vulnerability. Add unit tests: Fragile breaks from adjacent explosion, Fragile breaks from adjacent neutralization, Fragile not adjacent is safe, Fragile blocked from Gravity bag, chain: explosion breaks adjacent Fragile.
tasks.verification: dotnet test -- Fragile vulnerability tests pass

(3) Catalytic and Stable adjacent to each other should cancel out (net zero modifier). (4) Update ReactionRuleDatabase if needed. Add unit tests: Catalytic lowers threshold causing reaction, Catalytic+Stable cancel out, multiple Catalytic cells stack, Catalytic alone does nothing (no reaction to amplify).
tasks.verification: dotnet test -- Catalytic threshold lowering tests pass

tasks.title: Add Medicinal passive threshold reduction
tasks.description: Add Medicinal's primary mechanic: passively reduces cumulative thresholds (Overheating, Hypothermia, Poisoning) while carried. Implementation: (1) Add 'medicinal' to Aspect.FromId and the Intermediate aspect set. (2) In ChemistryEngine's WholeInventory tier evaluation, before checking cumulative totals against thresholds, sum all Medicinal magnitudes across the inventory and add them to the effective threshold. (3) This is passive (no consumption needed in puzzle mode). Add unit tests: Medicinal raises overheating threshold, Medicinal prevents poisoning that would otherwise trigger, multiple Medicinal reagents stack, Medicinal doesn't affect non-cumulative reactions.
